title: Vineyard Poker Championships
seo_title: Vineyard Poker Championships in Ozark, MO – Dec 8
description: The Vineyard Poker Championships is an invite-only poker tournament where players compete for one championship, with an evening of poker, fine cigars, good company, and a little friendly rivalry. It is for players who earned a seat through previous Vineyard poker nights, and the buy-in is $50. It takes place Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J, Ozark, MO; reserve by calling (417) 882-0399 or online.
